slice: Parse direct negative numeric literals before selecting a numeric type or checking its range

scope.production_change: Eight net lines in the shared SQL AST-to-spec conversion, reusing the existing numeric parsers. One native unit test covers types, bounds, parentheses/unary operators and signed zero.

corpus.origin: Locally designed numeric-boundary matrix, guided by the Spark grammar and the original long_min_literal mismatch; not an upstream CI corpus.
